critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/gmail.py scan_and_apply_all (~L322-468): good separation of concerns via shared apply_parsed_data helper. However, errors during body-decode or parser call are caught, counted into errors, but the email is NOT marked parsed — next run will re-attempt. For poison messages this could loop. Consider marking parsed=True with parse_error field to avoid repeated GPT-5.2 billing.

/app/backend/routes/gmail.py scan_and_apply_all fallback path (L365-382): when inbox cache is empty, emails are appended without `queued_at` / `parsed` flags, so subsequent runs won't dedupe them properly — consider persisting to gmail_inbox during the fallback.

/app/backend/services/subscription_detector.py likely_unused heuristic (L133-138): only triggers for Entertainment/Education/Shopping categories AND occurrence_count>=3 AND days_since_last_charge>=20. This is conservative — consider exposing the threshold as config so tests/main-agent can tune.
/app/backend/server.py /transactions/subscriptions/cancel: no input-length cap on merchant — user could write a 1MB string. Add max-length validation (e.g., 200 chars).

/app/backend/server.py get_recurring_subscriptions: hard-coded limit=500 transactions — power users with >500 txns may miss older subscription occurrences that would reveal yearly patterns. Consider paginating by date window instead of top-500.
